summary: Trump argues that restricting U.S. oil production under a Democratic administration would cause oil prices to spike dramatically, and that Biden's energy policies (high oil prices) directly fueled inflation and funded Russia's war in Ukraine. He frames domestic oil production as key to economic growth and deficit reduction.
quote: If this election were won by them, I can tell you right now, you would be— we would see oil go through the roof because they would really close it up.
